slides.title: *POV:* one free week and a bike
slides.body: Where would you ride? Dream route time.

slides.title: Pick your *dream route*
slides.body: Tour Divide, EuroVelo 6, Green Velo, Hebridean Way, Camino Francés. Or your own line.

slides.title: Turn it into *real days*
slides.body: Enter the distance. See riding days calculated from conditions, not just kilometres.

content.caption:
Bikepacking route ideas for one free week and a bike.

Dream routes are easier to start than you think. Pick a line on the map. Check the distance. Then work out how many realistic riding days it needs, not just kilometres.

Some well-known starting points: Tour Divide, EuroVelo 6 and 9, Green Velo, Hebridean Way, Camino Francés.
